title: What a meme template image shows
description: The vision model's answer for ONE blank template image (kg/template_entities.py). Handed to Ollama as the format= grammar and checked again with jsonschema; the pipeline then grounds every box and name before anything is stored. Editing this file re-queues every template (its sha is a staleness stamp).

name.description: Who or what it is: a proper name when recognised ('Drake', 'Kermit the Frog'), else a plain noun ('man', 'cat', 'phone').

named.description: true ONLY for the proper name of one specific real person, fictional character, brand, work or place; a kind of thing ('cat', 'door') is false.

box.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] on a 0-1000 grid of the whole image.

text.description: For kind 'text': the words printed in the image, exactly. Otherwise null.
